about.heading: A little about me.
text: My Computer Science degree gave me a foundation in structured thinking and problem-solving. Through my PGDM I'm now building toward Marketing and Human Resources, drawing on consumer-behaviour research, data analysis and technology-based projects.
I value communication, teamwork and time management, and I like learning by working with people and tackling practical challenges.
